Agent.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.version === 0,
					s.current_version_id === "",
					s.name === "",
					s.model_id === "",
					!s.has_system,
					s.system === "",
					!s.has_description,
					s.description === "",
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					s.status !== "",
					s.version >= 1,
					s.current_version_id !== "",
					s.name !== "",
					s.model_id !== "",
					[s.has_system, s.system === ""].some((ok) => ok),
					[s.has_description, s.description === ""].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.ConfigurationIsStableWithinAVersio.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				after.version !== before.version,
				[
					after.current_version_id === before.current_version_id,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.model_id === before.model_id,
					after.has_system === before.has_system,
					after.system === before.system,
					after.has_description === before.has_description,
					after.description === before.description,
					after.mcp_servers === before.mcp_servers,
					after.tools === before.tools,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.ArchivedAgentStaysArchived.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "archived",
				[
					after.status === "archived",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.current_version_id === before.current_version_id,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.model_id === before.model_id,
					after.has_system === before.has_system,
					after.system === before.system,
					after.has_description === before.has_description,
					after.description === before.description,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[
					after.status !== "",
					[
						after.version === before.version,
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.version === 0, s.name === ""].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.version >= 1, s.name !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.ConfiguredExactlyWhenCreated.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.description === null, s.config === null].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.config !== null].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.ArchivedNeverReactivates.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "archived",
				[
					after.status === "archived",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.DeletedStaysDeleted.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "deleted",
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[
					before.status === "",
					[
						[after.status === "", after.version === 0].every((ok) => ok),
						[after.status === "active", after.version === 1].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					before.status !== "",
					after.status !== "",
					[
						[after.version === before.version, after.name === before.name].every((ok) => ok),
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Session.InitialMessagesAreBoundedAndOnly.source:
(s) =>
			s._tag !== "Idle" ||
			s.initial_messages_remaining === undefined ||
			(s.turn === 0 &&
				s.initial_messages_remaining >= 0 &&
				s.initial_messages_remaining <= MAX_SESSION_INITIAL_EVENTS)

Session.OnlyTheNextInitialMessageCanAdva.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "RecordInitialMessage" ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			(before._tag === "Idle" && before.initial_messages_remaining === command.remaining)

Session.OnlyTheLastInitialMessageStartsT.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "RecordInitialMessage" ||
			!events.some((e) => e._tag === "session.status_running") ||
			(before._tag === "Idle" && before.initial_messages_remaining === 1)

Session.TurnNeverDecreases.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn >= before.turn

Session.TurnAdvancesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn <= before.turn + 1

Session.ModelRequestsStartedNeverDecreas.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started >= before.model_requests_started

Session.ModelRequestsStartedGrowsByAtMos.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started <= before.model_requests_started + 1

Session.PendingUserMessagesGrowsByAtMost.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.pending_user_messages <= before.pending_user_messages + 1

Session.OnlySendUserMessageAddsPendingMe.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.pending_user_messages <= before.pending_user_messages ||
			command._tag === "SendUserMessage"

Session.OnlyArchiveSessionSetsArchivedFl.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			after._tag !== "Terminated" ||
			!after.archived ||
			(before._tag === "Terminated" && before.archived) ||
			command._tag === "ArchiveSession"

Session.IdleSessionStartsTheNextTurn.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Idle" || after._tag !== "Running" || after.turn === before.turn + 1

Session.StatusRunningCarriesStartedTurn.source:
({ after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_running" ||
					(after._tag === "Running" && event.turn === after.turn),
			)

Session.StatusIdleCarriesEndedTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_idle" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === before.turn &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" || after._tag === "Running")),
			)

Session.AbandonedTurnEnds.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.abandoned" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === before.turn &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" ||
							(after._tag === "Running" && after.turn === before.turn + 1))),
			)

Session.AgentMessageEndsTheTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "agent.message" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" ||
							(after._tag === "Running" && after.turn === before.turn + 1))),
			)

Session.OnlyAPauseMakesATurnWait.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			!after.paused ||
			(before._tag === "Running" && before.turn === after.turn && before.paused) ||
			events.some((event) => event._tag === "turn.awaiting")

Session.APauseKeepsTheTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.awaiting" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						after._tag === "Running" &&
						after.turn === before.turn &&
						after.paused),
			)

Session.AContinuationKeepsTheTurn.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.continued" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						after._tag === "Running" &&
						after.turn === before.turn &&
						!after.paused),
			)

Session.APausedTurnGoesOnOnceAnswered.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.paused ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.awaiting_calls >= 1 ||
			(!after.paused && events.some((event) => event._tag === "turn.continued"))

Session.AnInterruptEndsAPausedTurn.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.paused ||
			command._tag !== "SendUserInterrupt" ||
			after._tag === "Idle" ||
			(after._tag === "Running" && after.turn === before.turn + 1)

Session.AnInterruptedTurnNeitherWaitsNor.source:
({ before, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupted ||
			events.every((event) => event._tag !== "turn.awaiting" && event._tag !== "turn.continued")

Session.AnInterruptedTurnStaysInterrupte.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupted ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.interrupted

Session.ADeadlineAbandonsOnlyItsOwnSegme.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "AbandonTurn" ||
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			command.segment ===
				(before.open_model_request_id === null && !before.paused
					? before.model_requests_started + 1
					: before.model_requests_started)

Session.AnEndedTurnStartsTheQueuedOne.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			before.pending_user_messages === 0 ||
			after._tag !== "Idle" ||
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_idle" ||
					(event.stop_reason.type !== "end_turn" &&
						event.stop_reason.type !== "retries_exhausted" &&
						event.stop_reason.type !== "interrupted"),
			)

Session.AStopNamesTheUnansweredCalls.source:
({ before, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					(event._tag !== "session.status_idle" && event._tag !== "session.status_terminated") ||
					event.event_ids === (before._tag === "Running" ? before.awaiting_ids : NO_TOOL_USE_IDS),
			)

Automation.NothingRunsBeforeCreation.source:
(s) =>
			[
				s.status !== "",
				[s.runs === 0, s.reported === 0, s.last_scheduled_at === 0, s.activation === 0].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.OnlyUnpauseResumesAPausedAuto.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "paused",
				after.status !== "active",
				command._tag === "ResumeAutomation",
			].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.RunsGrowByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[after.runs === before.runs, after.runs === before.runs + 1].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.OnlyRunAndFireStartRuns.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				after.runs === before.runs,
				command._tag === "RunAutomation",
				command._tag === "FireAutomation",
			].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.OnlyAResumeOrAnUpdateStartsAN.source:
({ before, after, command, events }) =>
			[
				after.activation === before.activation,
				[
					command._tag === "ResumeAutomation",
					before.status === "paused",
					after.activation === before.activation + 1,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					events.some((event) => event._tag === "automation.updated"),
					before.status === "active",
					after.activation === before.activation + 1,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.EveryResumeStartsANewActivati.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "automation.unpaused" || after.activation === before.activation + 1,
			)

Automation.FiredCarriesTheNewRun.source:
({ after, events }) =>
			events.every((event) => event._tag !== "automation.fired" || event.run === after.runs)

Automation.RunsAreReportedInOrder.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[after.reported === before.reported, after.reported === before.reported + 1].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.OnlyCreationOrAnUpdateRevises.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			[
				after.revision === before.revision,
				[before.status === "", after.revision === 1].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					events.some((event) => event._tag === "automation.updated"),
					after.revision === before.revision + 1,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Automation.AnUpdateLeavesRunsAlone.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every((event) => event._tag !== "automation.updated") ||
			[
				after.runs === before.runs,
				after.reported === before.reported,
				after.last_scheduled_at === before.last_scheduled_at,
			].every((ok) => ok)

Automation.AFailedRunPausesOnlyAnActiveA.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				command._tag !== "RecordAutomationRunFailed",
				after.status === before.status,
				[before.status === "active", after.status === "paused"].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

AutomationCapacity.SlotsChangeOneAtATime.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.reserved === before.reserved,
				after.reserved === before.reserved + 1,
				after.reserved === before.reserved - 1,
			].some((ok) => ok)

CreateAgent.NewAgentStartsAtVersionOne.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				before.agent.status === "",
				after.agent.status === "active",
				after.agent.version === 1,
				after.agent.current_version_id === command.version_id,
			].every((ok) => ok)

CreateAgent.NewAgentKeepsItsDeclaredServ.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before.agent.status !== "" || after.agent.mcp_servers === command.mcp_servers

CreateAgent.NewAgentKeepsItsDeclaredTool.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before.agent.status !== "" || after.agent.tools === command.tools

AdmitAutomation.OnlyActiveAgentAndEnviro.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.agent.status === "active",
				before.environment.status === "active",
				before.automation.status === "",
				after.automation.status === "active",
			].every((ok) => ok)

AdmitAutomation.PinnedVersionWithinAgent.source:
({ before, command }) =>
			command.agent_version === null || command.agent_version <= before.agent.version

AdmitAutomation.AdmissionTakesOneSlotWit.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.capacity.reserved < MAX_LIVE_AUTOMATIONS,
				after.capacity.reserved === before.capacity.reserved + 1,
			].every((ok) => ok)

AdmitAutomation.AdmissionLeavesAgentAndE.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.agent.status === before.agent.status,
				after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
				after.environment.status === before.environment.status,
				after.environment.version === before.environment.version,
			].every((ok) => ok)

OpenAutomationSession.OnlyActiveAgentAnd.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.agent.status === "active",
				before.environment.status === "active",
				before.session._tag === "Uninitialized",
				after.session._tag === "Running",
			].every((ok) => ok)

OpenAutomationSession.AnAutomationSessio.source:
({ after, events }) =>
			after.session._tag === "Running" &&
			after.session.turn === 1 &&
			after.session.pending_user_messages === 0 &&
			events.length === 3

({ before, command }) =>
			command.agent_version === null || command.agent_version <= before.agent.version

OpenAutomationSession.FirstTurnAdmission.source:
({ command, events }) =>
			events.some(
				(event) =>
					event._tag === "session.created" &&
					event.mcp_server_credentials === command.mcp_server_credentials,
			)

OpenAutomationSession.OpeningAnAutomatio.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.agent.status === before.agent.status,
				after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
				after.environment.status === before.environment.status,
				after.environment.version === before.environment.version,
			].every((ok) => ok)

AutomationRuns.AStartedRunIsReported.source:
(m) =>
			m.Automation.some((automation) =>
				automation.events.some(
					(report) =>
						report._tag === "automation.run_started" &&
						m.Session.some(
							(session) =>
								session.id === report.session_id &&
								session.events.some(
									(created) =>
										created._tag === "session.created" && created.automation_id === automation.id,
								),
						),
				),
			)

Environment.AnUpdateAppliesOnlyAtTheExpe.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			command._tag !== "UpdateEnvironment" ||
			after.version === before.version ||
			command.expected_version === before.version

Session.AWorkerCommandRecordsOnlyForTheR.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			(command._tag !== "RecordModelRequestStart" &&
				command._tag !== "RecordToolCall" &&
				command._tag !== "RecordToolResult" &&
				command._tag !== "PauseTurn" &&
				command._tag !== "CommitModelReply" &&
				command._tag !== "FailModelRequest" &&
				command._tag !== "InterruptModelRequest" &&
				command._tag !== "AbandonTurn") ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			(before._tag === "Running" && before.turn === command.turn)

Session.AUserMessageWaitsForTheInitialMe.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "SendUserMessage" ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			before._tag !== "Idle" ||
			!before.initial_messages_remaining

OpenAutomationSession.AnAutomationSessio.source:
({ command, events }) =>
			events.some(
				(event) =>
					event._tag === "session.created" && event.automation_id === command.automation_id,
			)

Session.ATruncatedReplyNeverEndsTheTurnA.source:
({ command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "CommitModelReply" ||
			command.truncated !== true ||
			events.every(
				(event) => event._tag !== "session.status_idle" || event.stop_reason.type !== "end_turn",
			)

Session.FencingClosesAnUninitializedSess.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			command._tag !== "FenceSessionAdmission" ||
			before._tag !== "Uninitialized" ||
			after._tag === "Terminated"
